actual: Submitted an application for job-4 (Jamie Carter) which appeared correctly in the employer dashboard (job-4 applications count = 1, total = 4) while navigating via in-app links. evidence: On /jobs/job-1, filled Full Name, valid Email, Phone, Message and clicked Submit Application; a toast appeared: 'Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent.' Form fields cleared after submission.

Entering 'not-an-email' in Email triggered 'Please include an @ in the email address...' validation message identifying the invalid field and blocking submission.

issue: Job publish accepts invalid salary range and missing required skill
actual: Submitted the Post Job form with Min Salary=100000, Max Salary=50000 (min > max), no skills added, but all other required fields filled. The form accepted it: toast 'Job posted successfully!' appeared and the job 'QA Test Job' was created and now appears in the employer dashboard showing 'Remote · $100k - $50k · Posted Yesterday' with 0 required skills. No validation error was shown for the invalid salary range or missing skill.

evidence: Created 'QA Automation Engineer' job (Engineering, Full-time, Boston MA, $90k-$130k, description, skill 'Selenium'). Toast confirmed posting; job appeared in employer dashboard (active jobs count incremented 5->7) and in job-seeker listing (Showing 10 jobs) with all entered details.
Dashboard lists 5 jobs (job-1,2,4,6,7) matching 'Active Jobs: 5'; per-job application counts (2,1,0,0,0) sum to 3, matching 'Total Applications: 3'.
Clicking the applications toggle (count '2') for 'Senior Frontend Developer' expanded an 'Applications (2)' panel listing Alex Johnson and Maria Garcia's application details.
Each application record shows name (e.g. 'Alex Johnson'), email ('alex.j@email.com'), phone ('555-0101'), message text, and submission date ('Jan 20') as a distinct entry.

Submitted application (Priya Nair, priya.nair@example.com) for job-2 showed success toast, and appeared exactly once in employer dashboard under 'Product Designer' applications list (count 1->2) with matching name, email, and message.

actual: After submitting an application to job-2 with email priya.nair@example.com, submitted a second application to the same job using the identical email address ('Priya Nair Duplicate'). The app accepted it with the same success toast ('Application submitted!') and no warning. The employer dashboard confirmed job-2's application count increased from 2 to 3 (total 4 to 5), meaning a second application with an already-used email was saved rather than rejected.

Inspected the employer dashboard's job listing rows: each job only exposes an applications-count toggle and a delete (trash) icon button — no edit/pencil control, no edit link, and no /employer/edit-job route. Checked all buttons and links on the dashboard page via DOM inspection; none reference editing a job. There is no way for an employer to modify a published job's details.

evidence: Clicking delete icon for 'Marketing Manager' opened confirmation dialog 'Delete this job? This will permanently delete... and all its applications.' Confirming removed it: dashboard active jobs 5->4, job-seeker listing 8->7 (job-4 no longer present in either).
